Windows on your other computers

Pick one to copy it again, on any computer. Press C in the island to come here.

Drop files on the island to keep them here. Click one from another computer to copy it to this one.

Every computer's open apps, what runs in the background, and all its apps. Click one to switch to it or open it (the pointer follows); ✕ quits it.

Your phone

Starting…

Point the camera of your iPhone or Android phone at the code. It needs to be on the same Wi‑Fi.

From the phone: files land in Downloads › OpenHop, or go to any computer, all of them, or the shelf. The phone also gets the shelf, clipboard history, music and a trackpad.

Send

Let go over a computer to send it there, or anywhere else to keep it on the shelf.
